planned: Parent 20-second /proc CPU/RSS plus readable cgroup observations.
actual: Frozen bounded_stage.py records owned /proc CPU ticks and RSS pages every 20 seconds. It does not capture cgroup memory.events/limits in the periodic stream.
deviation: Cgroup periodic sampling was not implemented; historical missing measurements are not fabricated or replaced with later reads.
impact: No inference about OOM absence, host-wide resource isolation or the cause of historical R407 is permitted. Actual child exits, owned process cleanup and source checks are recorded independently.
scope: Reporting limitation; no product/test/observer changes or extra behavioral runs.
